import pandas as pd

def main():
    # List of source file paths
    source_files = [
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_92/test_0.csv"
        # Add more source files here if available
    ]

    # List to hold DataFrames
    dfs = []

    for file_path in source_files:
        # Read source CSV
        df = pd.read_csv(file_path, encoding='utf-8')

        # Normalize user_id to lowercase
        df['user_id'] = df['user_id'].str.lower()

        # Append to list
        dfs.append(df)

    # Concatenate all source DataFrames
    target_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

    # Reorder columns to match target schema explicitly (optional here since same)
    target_df = target_df[['user_id', 'email', 'geo']]

    # Write to target CSV
    target_df.to_csv(
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_92/target_multisource_cot.csv",
        index=False,
        encoding='utf-8'
    )

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
